description:
Add or update an entry in your agency's AI use case inventory (OMB M-25-21). Every change creates a
new version and is written to your tamper-evident 'ai-inventory' log. Requires the organization API key.

actor.description: Who is making the change (person or agent)
actor.title: Actor

merge.description: Merge into the existing record (true) or replace it (false)
merge.title: Merge

use_case.description: AI use case record in OMB M-25-21 reporting fields. Required: use_case_id, name, stage (pre_deployment|pilot|deployed|retired), high_impact, purpose, outputs, sourcing (in_house|vendor|both), involves_pii, custom_code. Optional: bureau, contact_email, topic_area, ai_classification, withhold_from_public, expected_benefits, start_date, vendor_name, ato_system_name, data_description, open_data_link, pia_link, demographic_features, code_link, monitoring_streams (Ledger stream IDs), waivers [{practice, justification}], practices {name: {done, evidence, date}} with names: pre_deployment_testing, impact_assessment, independent_review, ongoing_monitoring, operator_training, fail_safe, appeal_process, public_feedback
use_case.title: Use Case

name: gov_ai_usecase_save
title: Save an AI use case
